_doc: OKe e2e benchmark tasks. {run} in a prompt becomes the run dir (c:/... with forward slashes). Tasks run in `order`; tasks with the same `group` are sent one after another and waited for together. `popups`: rules tried in order before `global_popups`; the first rule whose `when` regex matches the popup screen (and whose `kind`, `after` and `times` fit) decides. Actions: `first` (option 1, which OKe marks Recommended / approve), {"pick": regex on the option labels}, {"type": text} (the free-text option, then Enter). No rule matches: `first`. `expect`: checks score.py runs (see score.py CHECKS).
_avoid_doc: `first` means the first option whose label does not match avoid_options (never cancel, delete or go to a pane); when every option matches, option 1

global_popups.note: a child's permission dialog for a destructive command: deny

shop PM으로 {run}/shop-add-tax 에 shop.py 의 함수 목록을 HTML 보고서(functions.html)로 만들어줘. 커밋하지 말고 그 자리에 그냥 둬.

{run}/calc 에 pow(a, b) 함수 추가해줘. 테스트도 넣고. 묻지 말고 진행해.
calc PM으로 {run}/calc main checkout에서 바로 calc.py 에 mod(a, b) 함수 추가해줘. worktree 말고 main에서 작업해줘.
calc PM으로 {run}/calc main checkout에서 바로 calc.py 에 neg(a) 함수도 추가해줘. 이것도 worktree 말고 main에서.

do.type: 목차 항목마다 그 문서가 무엇인지 한 줄 설명을 붙여줘.

checklist.A1: small request: PM writes the plan, one approval popup, at most 1-2 popups
checklist.A1b: interview only when the words name nothing concrete
checklist.A2: a named PM (or the only PM of that path) gets the job without a PM-pick popup
checklist.A3: per-job auto approval ('묻지 말고'): one confirm popup, then no approval popup
checklist.A4: no baseline step; a failing check is compared with the base automatically
checklist.B5: in place: only the job's files are committed; the user's other uncommitted files stay
checklist.B6: an existing linked worktree is the job's place; commits go on its branch
checklist.B7: a plan's commit groups become separate commits
checklist.B9: a second in-place job on the same checkout waits and starts by itself
checklist.C10: a result (HTML) stays uncommitted in the existing place, no new worktree
checklist.C11: the plan decides the result path
checklist.D13: text typed in the approval popup is the change request at once
checklist.U1: git handling is not excessive (see B5-B7)
checklist.answer-only: a question ends with an answer: no plan approval, no branch, no commit
checklist.check-none: a docs-only job has check none and the review grades every criterion
checklist.A1b-interview: a vague request gets an interview
checklist.A2-only-fit: the only PM that worked on a path takes it without a popup
